name: PatreonCredits
description: Generate professional scrolling end-credits videos (MP4) for YouTube content creators, featuring their Patreon supporters. Fetch patrons directly from the Patreon API or paste custom names. Supports 35 bundled fonts with CJK character support, 1-5 column layouts, 720p/1080p/4K resolution, and fully customizable colors, sizes, and styling. Includes a web-based UI, REST API, and Swagger docs.

paths.name: Output Directory
paths.description: Directory where generated videos are saved.

variables.name: Patreon Token
variables.description: Patreon Creator Access Token. Leave empty to configure in the web UI or use dummy data.

variables.name: Campaign ID
variables.description: Patreon Campaign ID. Leave empty to configure in the web UI.

variables.name: Use Dummy Data
variables.description: Use dummy patron names for testing without Patreon credentials.
